title: Claude Code Built My Entire Business Command Center in One Sitting
description:
I gave Claude Code's new Opus 4.8 model one prompt and walked out to drive my dog to the vet. I came back to a finished agentic operating system: one dashboard tracking industry drops, competitors, my YouTube and social stats, every active project, and one-click access to my most-used skills. Thousands of dollars and weeks of dev work, done in a single session with nobody watching.
